key_insight: Convolutional neural networks segmented friction stir weld surface defects at pixel level, achieving 97.69% global accuracy and 83.78% mean intersection over union (mIoU).
engineering_relevance: Automated defect identification, localization, and quantification could support inline weld inspection and reduce reliance on time-consuming human visual assessment.
method: Apply CNN-based semantic segmentation to weld surface images.
Identify flash, surface galling, and surface lack of fill.
Evaluate pixel-level performance using global accuracy and IoU.
evidence_signal: Reported defect IoUs were 79.18% for flash, 80.22% for surface lack of fill, and 66.87% for surface galling.
watch_item: Surface galling had the lowest reported defect IoU; the abstract does not establish robustness across production conditions or real-time deployment.
paper_title: Image segmentation in friction stir welding using convolutional neural networks
